patch.summary: Capsule implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Capsule by mapping current crm workflows to Capsule objects, confirming plan gates for lead management (Starter, Growth, Advanced, Ultimate), custom pipelines (Growth, Advanced, Ultimate), email sync (Starter, Growth, Advanced, Ultimate), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Gmail, Outlook, QuickBooks) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: lead management (Starter, Growth, Advanced, Ultimate)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Gmail

blocks.heading: Capsule day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Capsule setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management, lead management, pipeline management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Small businesses wanting a simple CRM before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Gmail and Outlook before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover lead management (Starter, Growth, Advanced, Ultimate)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Workflow automations and advanced reporting start at Growth; enrichment at Advanced.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Not a marketing automation or sales-engagement suite — email templates ≠ full campaign platform.

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Capsule plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · up to 2 users, up to 250 contacts, up to 1 pipeline, up to 5 custom fields · Unlocks: contact management, pipeline management, deal management · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Starter
lines.description: 14-day trial · up to 30,000 contacts · Unlocks: lead management, email sync, email sequences · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Growth
lines.description: 14-day trial · up to 60,000 contacts · Unlocks: custom pipelines, workflow automation, sales automation · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Advanced
lines.description: 14-day trial · up to 120,000 contacts · Unlocks: data enrichment · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Ultimate
lines.description: 14-day trial · up to 240,000 contacts · Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate crm fit before a deep Capsule rollout
blocks.body: If Capsule fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Capsule object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate Streak before sunk-cost expansion
